procedure_deduplication: whitespace-normalized cleaned text; union provenance; one lexicographically first reference URL
tram_deduplication: whitespace-normalized sentence; union labels and report memberships
ransomware_related_slice: ransom substring in malware description (case-insensitive); not a malware taxonomy
tram_ransomware_slice: ransom substring in any member doc_title (case-insensitive)

bootstrap.tram_unit: report connected components via duplicate sentences

demo.family_query: minimum sha256 of stable query ID
demo.fill: remaining distinct families ordered by sha256 of family ID

limitations: ATT&CK questions are structured-label-derived, not independent human QA
Agent cases are positive-derived; no balanced factual accuracy
NLI threshold transferred unchanged from science calibration; not calibrated for cybersecurity
TRAM labels may be incomplete and include historical techniques
Source withdrawal measures dependence, not source independence or factual truth
No hyperparameter tuning on evaluation outcomes
